_comment: VERSIONED STATION-STATE EVIDENCE SCHEMA (EVID-02-adjacent / Workstream C initial-state evidence). Documents the record shape a real, cited, per-origin initial-state submission must satisfy. The 8 REQUIRED_STATION_STATE_FIELDS below are reused VERBATIM from system/evaluation/n6_multi_origin_harness/adapters.py (the exact positional-argument contract of system/schemas/station_state.py's StationState.from_dict) -- never redefined or widened here. This file documents the contract; it is not itself imported by any code (the authoritative, enforced field list lives in adapters.py). Validation against this schema is performed by tools/evidence_acquisition/validate_station_state_evidence.py, which imports adapters.py's REQUIRED_STATION_STATE_FIELDS rather than duplicating it.

additional_evidence_metadata_fields_this.origin_id: string -- the forecast-origin timestamp this record's state applies to at t0. Must match the key used in the authoritative_initial_states_by_origin registry.
additional_evidence_metadata_fields_this.station_identity: string -- e.g. 'Nuolja Middle Station'. Never blank.
additional_evidence_metadata_fields_this.measurement_timestamp_utc: ISO-8601 string with explicit UTC offset -- when the UNDERLYING measurement was actually taken (may differ from 'timestamp', which is the StationState's own t0 field; this field exists so a submission can be checked for staleness against t0).

units.diesel_fuel_remaining_liters: liters (optional field; None/absent means genuinely unknown, never 0)

additional_evidence_metadata_fields_this.source_reference: string -- exact citation of the measurement source (SCADA log id, meter serial + read, manual log entry + inspector name/date). Must be independently checkable, not merely asserted.

calibration_quality_metadata.instrument_last_calibrated_utc: ISO-8601 UTC or 'UNKNOWN' (explicit, never silently omitted)
calibration_quality_metadata.measurement_quality_flag: one of: VERIFIED | UNVERIFIED | SUSPECT | UNKNOWN

record_shape.explicit_missingness_policy: A field this schema lists is either present with a real measured/cited value, or explicitly absent/null. An absent field must NEVER be filled with a smoke-test constant, a mean, a default, or any other invented value and then labeled authoritative. system/evaluation/n6_multi_origin_harness/adapters.py's resolve_and_validate_authoritative_initial_state(...) enforces this for the 8 core StationState fields and the provenance field by raising MalformedInitialStateRecordError on any missing one -- this schema's additional metadata fields are checked by the completeness/quality report (see validate_station_state_evidence.py) but do NOT block the core validator, since they are evidence-quality context, not part of the StationState construction contract itself.

example_submission_NOT_REAL_DATA._comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SHAPE ONLY. Every value below is a placeholder, not a real Nuolja measurement. Do not use this example as a stand-in for real station evidence.
example_submission_NOT_REAL_DATA.timestamp: <REPLACE: same as origin_id or the StationState's own t0>
